message: `mlpareto2` requires `min` (lower endpoint); it has no default. With min estimated the likelihood is unbounded: let min rise to the sample minimum with scale equal to the gap and shape below k/(n - k), k the multiplicity of the minimum. Hold it, e.g. `mlpareto2(x, min = 0)`, which is `mllomax(x)`. Fits with min free and other parameters held are not supported.
